scope_limitations: Seven survey days at one intersection, four hourly peak intervals per day.
Degree of saturation is a calculated volume/capacity ratio, not speed, speed ratio or a 0–100 congestion score.
Raw vehicle counts by interval and raw speeds are not supplied in this table.
